meta.source: Theographic Bible Metadata (github.com/robertrouse/theographic-bible-metadata), json/people.json + verses.json + books.json
meta.method: books[] and verse/chapter counts are computed from each person's tagged verses. prominenceScore = round(100 × ln(1+verses) / ln(1+max verses)). Family edges marked source "theographic" come from the dataset's father/mother/children/siblings/partners fields; others are curated.
meta.datesNote: Dates follow Theographic's chronology, which is largely Ussher-based (creation 4004 BC, exodus 1491 BC); modern scholarly dates differ, especially before c. 900 BC. precision: "lifespan" = birth and death years in Theographic; "birth"/"death" = one end known; "attested" = years of the verses they appear in; "estimated" = interpolated by generation along the lineage.
meta.lineageNote: The lineage follows Theographic's father links from Jesus back to Adam: Luke 3 before Abraham (including Cainan, Luke 3:36), then the royal line of 1 Chronicles 3 and Matthew 1 through Joseph. It includes four kings Matthew omits and gives Pedaiah (1 Chr 3:19) as Zerubbabel's father. Luke's line from David through Nathan to Heli is not shown.
meta.eraNote: Theographic has no periods.json; eras are assigned editorially.

characters.name: Adam
characters.title: First Man
characters.summary: The first human, formed from the dust and placed in Eden; his disobedience brings sin and death into the world, a theme Paul contrasts with Christ as the "last Adam".

characters.name: Eve
characters.title: Mother of All Living
characters.summary: The first woman, created as Adam's partner; deceived by the serpent, she becomes the mother of Cain, Abel and Seth.

characters.name: Noah
characters.title: Builder of the Ark
characters.summary: A righteous man who built the ark and preserved his family and the animals through the flood, receiving God's rainbow covenant.

characters.name: Abraham
characters.title: Father of Nations
characters.summary: Called from Ur to Canaan, he received God's covenant promise of land, descendants and blessing to all nations, and is held up in the NT as the model of faith.

characters.name: Sarah
characters.title: Matriarch
characters.summary: Abraham's wife who, in old age, bore the promised son Isaac; she is honoured as the mother of the covenant line.

characters.name: Isaac
characters.title: Son of the Promise
characters.summary: The long-awaited son of Abraham and Sarah, nearly offered on Mount Moriah, through whom the covenant passed to Jacob.

characters.name: Rebekah
characters.title: Matriarch
characters.summary: Isaac's wife, chosen at the well in Haran, who helped Jacob obtain the birthright blessing over his twin Esau.

characters.name: Jacob (Israel)
characters.title: Patriarch of the Twelve Tribes
characters.summary: Grandson of Abraham, renamed Israel after wrestling with God; his twelve sons became the tribes of Israel.

characters.name: Esau
characters.title: Ancestor of Edom
characters.summary: Jacob's elder twin who sold his birthright for stew; he became the forefather of the Edomites.

characters.name: Rachel
characters.title: Matriarch
characters.summary: Jacob's beloved wife, for whom he served fourteen years; mother of Joseph and Benjamin, she died giving birth near Bethlehem.

characters.name: Leah
characters.title: Matriarch
characters.summary: Jacob's first wife and Rachel's elder sister; mother of six tribes including Levi (priesthood) and Judah (kingship).

characters.name: Joseph
characters.title: Vizier of Egypt
characters.summary: Jacob's favoured son, sold into slavery by his brothers, who rose to rule Egypt and saved his family from famine.

characters.name: Judah
characters.title: Patriarch of the Royal Tribe

dates.note: Alive at Jacob’s deathbed blessing (Gen 49); death year unknown.

characters.summary: Fourth son of Jacob and Leah whose tribe produced David's royal line and, in the NT, the Messiah.

characters.name: Job
characters.title: Righteous Sufferer
characters.summary: A blameless man of Uz who lost everything yet wrestled honestly with God; the book bearing his name is the Bible's great meditation on suffering.

characters.name: Moses
characters.title: Lawgiver & Prophet
characters.summary: Led Israel out of slavery in Egypt, received the Law at Sinai, and guided the people through forty years in the wilderness.

characters.name: Aaron
characters.title: First High Priest
characters.summary: Moses' elder brother and spokesman, consecrated as Israel's first high priest and founder of the Aaronic priesthood.

characters.name: Miriam
characters.title: Prophetess
characters.summary: Sister of Moses and Aaron who led Israel's women in the victory song after crossing the Red Sea.

characters.name: Joshua
characters.title: Successor of Moses
characters.summary: Moses' aide and successor who led Israel across the Jordan and into the conquest and settlement of Canaan.

characters.name: Caleb
characters.title: Faithful Spy
characters.summary: One of only two spies who trusted God's promise to give Canaan to Israel; he later claimed Hebron as his inheritance.

characters.name: Deborah
characters.title: Judge & Prophetess
characters.summary: The only female judge of Israel, who summoned Barak to defeat the Canaanite general Sisera and sang a victory song.

characters.name: Gideon
characters.title: Judge of Israel
characters.summary: A reluctant farmer called to deliver Israel from Midian, defeating a vast army with just 300 men.

characters.name: Samson
characters.title: Nazirite Judge
characters.summary: A Nazirite of superhuman strength who fought the Philistines, was betrayed by Delilah, and died bringing down a Philistine temple.

characters.name: Ruth
characters.title: Moabite Ancestor of David

dates.note: Theographic gives birth 1114 BC but dates the Book of Ruth to c. 1307 BC; the narrative date is used.

characters.summary: A Moabite widow whose loyalty to Naomi and to Israel's God led to her marriage to Boaz, making her David's great-grandmother.

characters.name: Naomi
characters.title: Mother-in-law of Ruth
characters.summary: An Israelite widow who returned from Moab to Bethlehem in bitterness and saw her family line restored through Ruth.

characters.name: Boaz
characters.title: Kinsman-Redeemer

dates.note: Dated with the Book of Ruth (c. 1307 BC in Theographic); later uses of his name for a temple pillar omitted.

characters.summary: A worthy landowner of Bethlehem who acted as kinsman-redeemer for Ruth and Naomi; ancestor of David and Jesus.

characters.name: Hannah
characters.title: Mother of Samuel
characters.summary: A barren woman whose fervent prayer at Shiloh was answered with Samuel, whom she dedicated to God; her song anticipates Mary's Magnificat.

characters.name: Eli
characters.title: High Priest at Shiloh
characters.summary: Priest and judge at Shiloh who raised the boy Samuel; his house fell under judgment for his sons' corruption.

characters.name: Samuel
characters.title: Prophet & Last Judge
characters.summary: Israel's last judge and a great prophet who anointed both Saul and David, guiding the transition to monarchy.

characters.name: Saul
characters.title: First King of Israel
characters.summary: Israel's first king, anointed by Samuel, whose disobedience cost him the throne and whose jealousy drove him to hunt David.

characters.name: Jonathan
characters.title: Prince of Israel
characters.summary: Saul's valiant son whose covenant friendship with David is one of Scripture's great portraits of loyalty.

characters.name: David
characters.title: King of Israel
characters.summary: Shepherd, giant-slayer, psalmist and Israel's greatest king, to whom God promised an everlasting dynasty fulfilled in the Messiah.

characters.name: Bathsheba
characters.title: Queen Mother
characters.summary: Wife of Uriah taken by David, she later became queen mother and secured the throne for her son Solomon.

characters.name: Solomon
characters.title: King of Israel
characters.summary: David's son, famed for wisdom and wealth, who built the First Temple in Jerusalem but was led astray by foreign wives.

characters.name: Nathan
characters.title: Court Prophet
characters.summary: The prophet who delivered God's dynastic promise to David, confronted him over Bathsheba, and helped crown Solomon.

characters.name: Absalom
characters.title: Rebel Prince

dates.note: Ends at his death in 2 Sam 18; later mentions of "Abishalom" omitted.

characters.summary: David's handsome son who seized the throne in revolt and was killed by Joab, to David's bitter grief.

characters.name: Joab
characters.title: Commander of David's Army
characters.summary: David's nephew and ruthless army commander, loyal to the kingdom yet often defying David's wishes.

characters.name: Elijah
characters.title: Prophet
characters.summary: The fiery prophet who confronted Ahab and the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel and was taken to heaven in a whirlwind.

characters.name: Elisha
characters.title: Prophet
characters.summary: Elijah's successor who received a double portion of his spirit and performed many miracles in the Northern Kingdom.

characters.name: Ahab
characters.title: King of Israel
characters.summary: A powerful Northern king who, with Jezebel, promoted Baal worship and repeatedly clashed with Elijah.

characters.name: Jezebel
characters.title: Queen of Israel
characters.summary: Phoenician queen of Ahab who championed Baal worship, persecuted the prophets, and sought Elijah's life.

characters.name: Hezekiah
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: A reforming king of Judah who trusted God during the Assyrian siege of Jerusalem under Sennacherib.

characters.name: Josiah
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: Judah's last great reformer, who renewed the covenant after the Book of the Law was rediscovered in the temple.

characters.name: Isaiah
characters.title: Prophet
characters.summary: Jerusalem's great prophet of holiness and hope, whose oracles of the Servant and Immanuel are quoted throughout the NT.

characters.name: Jeremiah
characters.title: The Weeping Prophet
characters.summary: Prophet to Judah's final decades who warned of Babylon's judgment, witnessed Jerusalem's fall, and foretold a new covenant.

characters.name: Daniel
characters.title: Prophet in Babylon
characters.summary: A Judean exile who rose high in the Babylonian and Persian courts, survived the lions' den, and received apocalyptic visions.

characters.name: Ezekiel
characters.title: Prophet of the Exile
characters.summary: Priest-prophet among the exiles in Babylon whose visions of God's glory, dry bones and a new temple promised restoration.

characters.name: Nebuchadnezzar
characters.title: King of Babylon

dates.note: Reigned 605–562 BC; retrospective mentions in Daniel 5 omitted.

characters.summary: The Babylonian king who destroyed Jerusalem in 586 BC, exiled Judah, and was humbled by God in the Book of Daniel.

characters.name: Esther
characters.title: Queen of Persia
characters.summary: A Jewish orphan who became queen of Persia and risked her life to save her people from Haman's genocide.

characters.name: Mordecai
characters.title: Guardian of Esther
characters.summary: Esther's cousin and guardian who refused to bow to Haman and later became second in rank to the Persian king.

characters.name: Haman
characters.title: Persian Vizier
characters.summary: The Agagite official who plotted to destroy the Jews of Persia and was hanged on the gallows he built for Mordecai.

characters.name: Cyrus
characters.title: King of Persia

dates.note: Conventional dates (reigned 559–530 BC); a retrospective mention in Daniel 1:21 omitted.

characters.summary: Persian conqueror of Babylon whose decree allowed the Jewish exiles to return and rebuild the temple; Isaiah calls him God's anointed.

characters.name: Ezra
characters.title: Priest & Scribe
characters.summary: Priest and scribe who led a return from Babylon and re-established the Law of Moses at the heart of Jerusalem's community.

characters.name: Nehemiah
characters.title: Governor of Judah

dates.note: Governor from the 20th to the 32nd year of Artaxerxes I (Neh 5:14; 13:6); Theographic dates nearly all his verses to 444 BC.

characters.summary: Cupbearer to Artaxerxes who became governor of Judah and rebuilt Jerusalem's walls in 52 days despite opposition.

characters.name: Jesus of Nazareth
characters.title: Messiah
characters.summary: The central figure of the NT—teacher, healer and Messiah—whose crucifixion and resurrection form the foundation of Christian faith.

characters.name: Mary
characters.title: Mother of Jesus
characters.summary: A young woman of Nazareth who conceived Jesus by the Holy Spirit, stood at the cross, and was among the first believers.

characters.name: Joseph of Nazareth
characters.title: Carpenter
characters.summary: A righteous carpenter of David's line who, guided by dreams, took Mary as his wife and protected the infant Jesus.

characters.name: John the Baptist
characters.title: Prophet & Forerunner

dates.note: Executed by Herod Antipas c. AD 29 (Mark 6); later mentions in Acts omitted.

characters.summary: The desert prophet who called Israel to repentance, baptized Jesus, and was beheaded by Herod Antipas.

characters.name: Peter
characters.title: Apostle

dates.note: Theographic dates John 1 to AD 5; start adjusted to the beginning of Jesus’ ministry (c. AD 26).

characters.summary: A Galilean fisherman who became the leading apostle, denied Jesus three times, and was restored to lead the early church.

characters.name: Andrew
characters.title: Apostle

dates.note: Theographic dates John 1 to AD 5; start adjusted to the beginning of Jesus’ ministry (c. AD 26).

characters.summary: A disciple of John the Baptist who followed Jesus first and brought his brother Simon Peter to him.

characters.name: James, son of Zebedee
characters.title: Apostle
characters.summary: One of Jesus' inner three disciples and the first apostle to be martyred, executed by Herod Agrippa I.

characters.name: John the Apostle
characters.title: Apostle
characters.summary: Son of Zebedee and member of the inner circle, traditionally the "beloved disciple" to whom Jesus entrusted his mother.

characters.name: Matthew (Levi)
characters.title: Apostle
characters.summary: A tax collector called from his booth to follow Jesus; the first Gospel is traditionally attributed to him.

characters.name: Judas Iscariot
characters.title: Apostle (Betrayer)
characters.summary: The disciple who kept the common purse and betrayed Jesus to the chief priests for thirty pieces of silver.

characters.name: Mary Magdalene
characters.title: Disciple
characters.summary: A follower healed by Jesus who stood by the cross and was the first witness to his resurrection.

characters.name: Martha
characters.title: Disciple of Bethany
characters.summary: Sister of Mary and Lazarus who hosted Jesus at Bethany and confessed him as the Christ before Lazarus was raised.

characters.name: Mary of Bethany
characters.title: Disciple of Bethany
characters.summary: Sister of Martha and Lazarus who sat at Jesus' feet to learn and later anointed him with costly perfume.

characters.name: Lazarus
characters.title: Friend of Jesus
characters.summary: Brother of Martha and Mary, raised by Jesus after four days in the tomb—a sign that hastened the plot against Jesus.

characters.name: Pontius Pilate
characters.title: Roman Governor of Judea

dates.note: Prefect of Judea AD 26–36; later retrospective mentions omitted.

characters.summary: The Roman prefect who presided over Jesus' trial and, despite finding no fault, sentenced him to crucifixion.

characters.name: James, brother of Jesus
characters.title: Leader of the Jerusalem Church
characters.summary: Initially sceptical, he became a pillar of the Jerusalem church, presided over the Jerusalem council and is traditionally the author of James.

characters.name: Stephen
characters.title: Deacon & First Martyr

dates.note: Martyred shortly after Pentecost (Acts 7); later retrospective mentions omitted.

characters.summary: One of the seven chosen to serve the Jerusalem church, stoned after a bold speech—the church's first martyr.

characters.name: Paul (Saul of Tarsus)
characters.title: Apostle to the Gentiles
characters.summary: A Pharisee and persecutor transformed on the Damascus road into the church's foremost missionary and author of thirteen letters.

characters.name: Barnabas
characters.title: Apostle & Missionary
characters.summary: The generous "son of encouragement" who vouched for Paul in Jerusalem and partnered with him on the first missionary journey.

characters.name: Timothy
characters.title: Missionary & Pastor
characters.summary: Paul's trusted protégé and co-worker, recipient of two pastoral letters, who led the church at Ephesus.

characters.name: Priscilla
characters.title: Teacher & Church Leader
characters.summary: Tentmaker and teacher who, with her husband Aquila, worked alongside Paul, hosted house churches, and instructed Apollos.

characters.name: Aquila
characters.title: Missionary & Tentmaker
characters.summary: A Jewish tentmaker from Pontus who, with his wife Priscilla, partnered with Paul in Corinth and Ephesus.

characters.name: Seth
characters.title: Son of Adam
characters.summary: Born to Adam and Eve after Abel's death; through him the godly line continued, when "men began to call upon the name of the LORD".

characters.name: Enosh
characters.title: Son of Seth
characters.summary: Son of Seth, in whose days people began to call on the name of the LORD (Gen 4:26).

characters.name: Kenan (Cainan)
characters.title: Antediluvian Patriarch
characters.summary: Son of Enosh and father of Mahalalel in the pre-flood line from Adam to Noah.

characters.name: Mahalalel
characters.title: Antediluvian Patriarch
characters.summary: Son of Kenan and father of Jared in the pre-flood genealogy of Genesis 5.

characters.name: Jared
characters.title: Antediluvian Patriarch
characters.summary: Son of Mahalalel and father of Enoch, said to have lived 962 years.

characters.name: Enoch
characters.title: Walked with God
characters.summary: Father of Methuselah who "walked with God, and he was not, for God took him"; Jude quotes a prophecy attributed to him.

characters.name: Methuselah
characters.title: Longest-lived Man
characters.summary: Son of Enoch and grandfather of Noah; at 969 years, the longest lifespan recorded in Scripture.

characters.name: Lamech
characters.title: Father of Noah
characters.summary: Son of Methuselah who named his son Noah, hoping he would bring rest from the cursed ground.

characters.name: Shem
characters.title: Son of Noah
characters.summary: Noah's son who survived the flood and was blessed by his father; ancestor of the Semitic peoples and of Abraham.

characters.name: Arphaxad
characters.title: Postdiluvian Patriarch
characters.summary: Son of Shem born two years after the flood, in the line leading to Abraham.

characters.name: Cainan (son of Arphaxad)
characters.title: Named in Luke's Genealogy
characters.summary: Listed only in Luke 3:36 (following the Septuagint) between Arphaxad and Shelah; absent from the Hebrew text of Genesis 11.

characters.name: Shelah (Salah)
characters.title: Postdiluvian Patriarch
characters.summary: Descendant of Arphaxad and father of Eber in the line from Shem to Abraham.

characters.name: Eber
characters.title: Ancestor of the Hebrews
characters.summary: Father of Peleg, traditionally regarded as the eponymous ancestor of the "Hebrews".

characters.name: Peleg
characters.title: Postdiluvian Patriarch
characters.summary: Son of Eber, "for in his days the earth was divided" (Gen 10:25).

characters.name: Reu
characters.title: Postdiluvian Patriarch
characters.summary: Son of Peleg and father of Serug in the line of Shem.

characters.name: Serug
characters.title: Postdiluvian Patriarch
characters.summary: Son of Reu and great-grandfather of Abraham.

characters.name: Nahor
characters.title: Grandfather of Abraham
characters.summary: Son of Serug and father of Terah, of Ur of the Chaldeans.

characters.name: Terah
characters.title: Father of Abraham
characters.summary: Father of Abram, Nahor and Haran, who set out from Ur toward Canaan and died in Haran.

characters.name: Perez (Pharez)
characters.title: Son of Judah
characters.summary: Son of Judah and Tamar who "broke through" ahead of his twin Zerah; head of the clan from which David came.

characters.name: Hezron
characters.title: Clan Head of Judah

dates.note: Listed among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob (Gen 46:12).

characters.summary: Son of Perez who went down to Egypt with Jacob's household; ancestor of David.

characters.name: Ram
characters.title: Ancestor of David
characters.summary: Son of Hezron in the tribe of Judah, listed in the genealogies of Ruth, Chronicles, Matthew and Luke.

characters.name: Amminadab
characters.title: Father-in-law of Aaron
characters.summary: Judahite ancestor of David whose daughter Elisheba married Aaron.

characters.name: Nahshon
characters.title: Prince of Judah
characters.summary: Leader of the tribe of Judah in the wilderness who brought the first tribal offering at the tabernacle's dedication.

characters.name: Salmon
characters.title: Father of Boaz
characters.summary: Son of Nahshon who, according to Matthew 1:5, fathered Boaz by Rahab of Jericho.

characters.name: Obed
characters.title: Son of Ruth and Boaz
characters.summary: Son of Boaz and Ruth, nursed by Naomi, and grandfather of King David.

characters.name: Jesse
characters.title: Father of David
characters.summary: Bethlehemite father of eight sons, the youngest of whom, David, Samuel anointed king; Isaiah foresees a "shoot from the stump of Jesse".

characters.name: Rehoboam
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: Solomon's son whose harsh policy split the kingdom, leaving him to rule only Judah and Benjamin.

characters.name: Abijah (Abijam)
characters.title: King of Judah

dates.note: Death year from Theographic; birth estimated.

characters.summary: Son of Rehoboam who reigned three years and fought Jeroboam of Israel.

characters.name: Asa
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: A long-reigning reformer who removed idols and deposed his grandmother Maacah for her Asherah image.

characters.name: Jehoshaphat
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: A faithful king who sent Levites to teach the Law but allied himself with Ahab of Israel.

characters.name: Jehoram of Judah
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: Son of Jehoshaphat who married Ahab's daughter Athaliah and followed the ways of Israel's kings.

characters.name: Ahaziah of Judah
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: Son of Jehoram and Athaliah, killed by Jehu after a one-year reign; one of three kings Matthew's genealogy omits.

characters.name: Joash (Jehoash)
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: Hidden as an infant from Athaliah's purge and crowned at seven; he repaired the temple under the priest Jehoiada.

characters.name: Amaziah
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: Son of Joash who defeated Edom but was routed by Jehoash of Israel and later assassinated.

characters.name: Uzziah (Azariah)
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: A prosperous king struck with leprosy for usurping the priests' role; Isaiah's call came "in the year that King Uzziah died".

characters.name: Jotham
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: Son of Uzziah who governed during his father's leprosy and "did what was right in the sight of the LORD".

characters.name: Ahaz
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: An idolatrous king who rejected Isaiah's Immanuel sign and turned to Assyria for help.

characters.name: Manasseh
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: Hezekiah's son and Judah's longest-reigning king, notorious for idolatry, who repented in Babylonian captivity (2 Chr 33).

characters.name: Amon
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: Son of Manasseh who continued his father's idolatry and was assassinated after two years.

characters.name: Jehoiakim
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: Son of Josiah, installed by Pharaoh Neco, who burned Jeremiah's scroll and became a vassal of Nebuchadnezzar.

characters.name: Jehoiachin (Jeconiah)
characters.title: King of Judah
characters.summary: Reigned three months before being taken to Babylon in 597 BC, where he was later released and honoured.

characters.name: Pedaiah
characters.title: Son of Jehoiachin

lineage.note: 1 Chr 3:19; Matthew 1:12 and Luke 3:27 name Shealtiel

characters.summary: Son of Jehoiachin named as Zerubbabel's father in 1 Chronicles 3:19, where Ezra, Haggai and the Gospels name Shealtiel.

characters.name: Shealtiel (Salathiel)
characters.title: Son of Jehoiachin
characters.summary: Son of the exiled King Jehoiachin, named in Ezra, Haggai, Matthew and Luke as the father of Zerubbabel.

characters.name: Zerubbabel
characters.title: Governor of Judah
characters.summary: Davidic heir and Persian-appointed governor who led the first return and rebuilt the temple, urged on by Haggai and Zechariah.

characters.name: Abiud
characters.title: Ancestor of Jesus
characters.summary: Son of Zerubbabel named in Matthew 1:13; nothing else is recorded of him.

characters.name: Eliakim
characters.title: Ancestor of Jesus
characters.summary: Son of Abiud in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus (Matt 1:13).

characters.name: Azor
characters.title: Ancestor of Jesus
characters.summary: Son of Eliakim in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus (Matt 1:13–14).

characters.name: Zadok (Sadoc)
characters.title: Ancestor of Jesus
characters.summary: Son of Azor in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus (Matt 1:14).

characters.name: Achim
characters.title: Ancestor of Jesus
characters.summary: Son of Zadok in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus (Matt 1:14).

characters.name: Eliud
characters.title: Ancestor of Jesus
characters.summary: Son of Achim in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus (Matt 1:14–15).

characters.name: Eleazar
characters.title: Ancestor of Jesus
characters.summary: Son of Eliud in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus (Matt 1:15).

characters.name: Matthan
characters.title: Ancestor of Jesus
characters.summary: Son of Eleazar and grandfather of Joseph in Matthew's genealogy (Matt 1:15).

characters.name: Jacob (father of Joseph)
characters.title: Ancestor of Jesus
characters.summary: Named in Matthew 1:16 as the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary (Luke 3:23 names Heli).

characters.name: Jonah
characters.title: Prophet to Nineveh
characters.summary: A prophet who fled God's call, was swallowed by a great fish, and saw Nineveh repent; Jesus cites "the sign of Jonah".

characters.name: Amittai
characters.title: Father of Jonah
characters.summary: Named only as the father of the prophet Jonah, from Gath-hepher (2 Kgs 14:25; Jonah 1:1).

characters.name: Nahum
characters.title: Prophet
characters.summary: The Elkoshite prophet who announced the fall of Nineveh, capital of Assyria.

characters.name: Habakkuk
characters.title: Prophet
characters.summary: A prophet who questioned God about injustice and the rise of Babylon, concluding "the righteous shall live by his faith".

characters.name: Haggai
characters.title: Prophet of the Restoration
characters.summary: Prophet who in 520 BC roused Zerubbabel, Joshua and the returned exiles to finish rebuilding the temple.

characters.name: Joshua (Jeshua) the High Priest
characters.title: High Priest
characters.summary: The first high priest after the exile, who led the rebuilding of the altar and temple with Zerubbabel.

characters.name: Jehozadak (Josedech)
characters.title: Priest
characters.summary: Priest carried into exile by Nebuchadnezzar; father of Joshua the high priest.

characters.name: Darius I
characters.title: King of Persia
characters.summary: Persian king whose reign dates Haggai's and Zechariah's prophecies and who confirmed Cyrus's decree to rebuild the temple.

characters.name: Gaius
characters.title: Beloved Host
characters.summary: Recipient of 3 John, commended by "the elder" for walking in the truth and hosting travelling missionaries.

characters.name: Diotrephes
characters.title: Church Leader
characters.summary: A domineering church leader in 3 John who "loves to be first", rejected the elder's authority and refused hospitality.

characters.name: Demetrius
characters.title: Commended Believer
characters.summary: A believer commended in 3 John as having "a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself".

characters.name: Cain
characters.title: First Murderer
characters.summary: Firstborn of Adam and Eve, a farmer who killed his brother Abel in jealousy and was sent out as a wanderer marked by God.

characters.name: Abel
characters.title: First Martyr
characters.summary: A shepherd whose offering God accepted, murdered by his brother Cain; Hebrews names him first among the faithful.

characters.name: Lot
characters.title: Nephew of Abraham
characters.summary: Abraham's nephew who settled near Sodom and was rescued before its destruction; ancestor of Moab and Ammon.

characters.name: Hagar
characters.title: Mother of Ishmael
characters.summary: Sarah's Egyptian servant who bore Ishmael to Abraham and twice met God in the wilderness, naming him "the God who sees".

characters.name: Ishmael
characters.title: Son of Abraham
characters.summary: Abraham's firstborn son by Hagar, promised to become a great nation; father of twelve princes.

characters.name: Pharaoh of the Exodus
characters.title: King of Egypt
characters.summary: The unnamed Egyptian king who hardened his heart against Moses' demands until the ten plagues and the Red Sea.

characters.name: Jethro (Reuel)
characters.title: Priest of Midian
characters.summary: Moses' father-in-law, a Midianite priest who advised him to appoint judges to share the burden of leadership.

characters.name: Zipporah
characters.title: Wife of Moses
characters.summary: Jethro's daughter who married Moses and circumcised their son to avert God's anger on the way to Egypt.

characters.name: Bezalel
characters.title: Master Craftsman
characters.summary: A Judahite artisan filled with the Spirit of God to craft the tabernacle, the ark and its furnishings.

characters.name: Nadab
characters.title: Son of Aaron
characters.summary: Aaron's eldest son, consumed by fire with Abihu for offering "strange fire" before the LORD.

characters.name: Abihu
characters.title: Son of Aaron
characters.summary: Aaron's second son who died with Nadab for offering unauthorized fire at the tabernacle.

characters.name: Korah
characters.title: Rebel Levite
characters.summary: A Levite who led a revolt against the leadership of Moses and Aaron and was swallowed by the earth.

characters.name: Balaam
characters.title: Mesopotamian Seer
characters.summary: A foreign diviner hired to curse Israel who, after his donkey spoke, could only bless; later blamed for Israel's sin at Peor.

characters.name: Balak
characters.title: King of Moab
characters.summary: The Moabite king who hired Balaam to curse the Israelites camped on the plains of Moab.

characters.name: Eleazar
characters.title: High Priest
characters.summary: Aaron's son and successor as high priest, who helped Joshua divide the land of Canaan among the tribes.

characters.name: Phinehas
characters.title: High Priest
characters.summary: Son of Eleazar whose zeal at Peor stopped a plague and earned a covenant of perpetual priesthood.

characters.name: Rahab
characters.title: Woman of Jericho
characters.summary: A Canaanite woman of Jericho who hid Joshua's spies, was spared with her family, and appears in Matthew's genealogy of Jesus.

characters.name: Achan
characters.title: Troubler of Israel
characters.summary: A Judahite who took forbidden plunder from Jericho, causing Israel's defeat at Ai, and was executed in the Valley of Achor.

characters.name: Othniel
characters.title: First Judge
characters.summary: Caleb's nephew and son-in-law, the first judge, who delivered Israel from Cushan-rishathaim of Mesopotamia.

characters.name: Ehud
characters.title: Left-handed Judge
characters.summary: A left-handed Benjaminite who assassinated the obese Moabite king Eglon and freed Israel from Moab.

characters.name: Barak
characters.title: Commander of Israel
characters.summary: Commander summoned by Deborah who routed Sisera's chariots at the Kishon; named among the faithful in Hebrews 11.

characters.name: Jael
characters.title: Slayer of Sisera
characters.summary: Wife of Heber the Kenite who killed the fleeing Canaanite general Sisera with a tent peg; "most blessed of women".

characters.name: Sisera
characters.title: Canaanite General
characters.summary: Commander of King Jabin's army with 900 iron chariots, defeated by Barak and killed by Jael.

characters.name: Abimelech (son of Gideon)
characters.title: Self-proclaimed King
characters.summary: Gideon's son who murdered seventy brothers to rule Shechem and was killed when a woman dropped a millstone on him.

characters.name: Jephthah
characters.title: Judge of Israel
characters.summary: A Gileadite outcast turned commander who defeated the Ammonites but bound himself by a rash vow concerning his daughter.

characters.name: Delilah
characters.title: Betrayer of Samson
characters.summary: A woman of the Valley of Sorek, bribed by the Philistine lords, who discovered the secret of Samson's strength.

characters.name: Goliath
characters.title: Philistine Champion
characters.summary: The giant of Gath who defied Israel's army and was killed by the young David with a sling and a stone.

characters.name: Abigail
characters.title: Wife of David
characters.summary: The discerning wife of Nabal whose intervention stopped David's revenge; she married David after Nabal's death.

characters.name: Abner
characters.title: Commander of Saul's Army
characters.summary: Saul's cousin and general who made Ish-bosheth king, then defected to David and was murdered by Joab.

characters.name: Ish-bosheth
characters.title: King of Israel
characters.summary: Saul's surviving son, installed as king over Israel by Abner, who was assassinated in his bed after two years.

characters.name: Mephibosheth
characters.title: Son of Jonathan
characters.summary: Jonathan's lame son to whom David showed covenant kindness, restoring Saul's land and seating him at the king's table.

characters.name: Uriah the Hittite
characters.title: Warrior of David
characters.summary: One of David's mighty men and Bathsheba's husband, whom David had killed in battle to cover his adultery.

characters.name: Jeroboam I
characters.title: First King of Israel (North)
characters.summary: Former official of Solomon who led the ten northern tribes away from Rehoboam and set up golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

characters.name: Naaman
characters.title: Aramean Commander
characters.summary: Commander of the army of Aram, healed of leprosy by washing seven times in the Jordan at Elisha's word.

characters.name: Jehu
characters.title: King of Israel
characters.summary: Army commander anointed at Elisha's command who wiped out Ahab's dynasty, killed Jezebel and purged Baal worship.

characters.name: Athaliah
characters.title: Queen of Judah
characters.summary: Daughter of Ahab who seized Judah's throne by killing the royal heirs; overthrown when the hidden Joash was crowned.

characters.name: Zadok
characters.title: High Priest
characters.summary: Priest loyal to David through Absalom's revolt who anointed Solomon king; his line held the high priesthood.

characters.name: Eliphaz the Temanite
characters.title: Friend of Job
characters.summary: The eldest of Job's three friends, who insisted that suffering must be the result of sin and was rebuked by God.

characters.name: Bildad the Shuhite
characters.title: Friend of Job
characters.summary: Job's second comforter, who appealed to tradition to argue that God never perverts justice.

characters.name: Zophar the Naamathite
characters.title: Friend of Job
characters.summary: The bluntest of Job's friends, who claimed Job deserved even worse than he suffered.

characters.name: Elihu
characters.title: Young Counsellor of Job
characters.summary: A younger man who spoke after the three friends, rebuking both them and Job and extolling God's greatness.

characters.name: Asaph
characters.title: Psalmist & Chief Musician
characters.summary: A Levite appointed by David to lead temple music, credited with twelve psalms (50, 73–83).

characters.name: Agur son of Jakeh
characters.title: Sage
characters.summary: An otherwise unknown sage whose sayings form Proverbs 30.

characters.name: King Lemuel
characters.title: King & Sage
characters.summary: A king whose mother's teaching—including the poem of the capable wife—forms Proverbs 31.

characters.name: Hosea
characters.title: Prophet
characters.summary: Prophet to the Northern Kingdom whose marriage to the unfaithful Gomer embodied God's love for faithless Israel.

characters.name: Gomer
characters.title: Wife of Hosea
characters.summary: Hosea's unfaithful wife, whose redemption pictured God's persistent love for Israel.

characters.name: Jezreel
characters.title: Son of Hosea
characters.summary: Hosea's first son, named for the valley of Jehu's bloodshed as a sign of judgment on Jehu's house.

characters.name: Lo-ruhamah
characters.title: Daughter of Hosea
characters.summary: Hosea's daughter, "Not pitied", whose name signalled judgment and was later reversed to "Pitied".

characters.name: Lo-ammi
characters.title: Son of Hosea
characters.summary: Hosea's son, "Not my people", a name reversed in promise and quoted by Paul and Peter.

characters.name: Joel
characters.title: Prophet

dates.note: Year of Joel 1:1 in Theographic; the quotation in Acts 2 omitted.

characters.summary: Prophet of the Day of the LORD whose promise that God would pour out his Spirit is quoted by Peter at Pentecost.

characters.name: Amos
characters.title: Prophet
characters.summary: A shepherd of Tekoa sent to the Northern Kingdom to denounce injustice: "let justice roll down like waters".

characters.name: Micah
characters.title: Prophet
characters.summary: A prophet from Moresheth who denounced Judah's injustice and foretold a ruler from Bethlehem.

characters.name: Zephaniah
characters.title: Prophet
characters.summary: A prophet of royal descent in Josiah's reign who warned of the coming Day of the LORD.

characters.name: Sennacherib
characters.title: King of Assyria
characters.summary: Assyrian king who besieged Jerusalem in Hezekiah's reign and withdrew after his army was struck down.

characters.name: Baruch
characters.title: Scribe of Jeremiah
characters.summary: Jeremiah's faithful scribe who wrote down and publicly read his prophecies.

characters.name: Zedekiah
characters.title: Last King of Judah
characters.summary: Judah's last king, installed by Nebuchadnezzar, whose rebellion led to Jerusalem's destruction in 586 BC.

characters.name: Ebed-melech
characters.title: Cushite Official
characters.summary: An Ethiopian court official who rescued Jeremiah from a muddy cistern and was promised his life.

characters.name: Obadiah
characters.title: Prophet
characters.summary: Author of the shortest OT book, an oracle against Edom for its betrayal of Jerusalem.

characters.name: Shadrach (Hananiah)
characters.title: Companion of Daniel
characters.summary: One of Daniel's three friends who refused to worship Nebuchadnezzar's golden image and survived the fiery furnace.

characters.name: Meshach (Mishael)
characters.title: Companion of Daniel
characters.summary: One of the three young Judeans delivered from the fiery furnace.

characters.name: Abednego (Azariah)
characters.title: Companion of Daniel
characters.summary: The third of Daniel's companions thrown into the furnace and delivered unharmed.

characters.name: Belshazzar
characters.title: Regent of Babylon
characters.summary: Babylon's ruler whose feast was interrupted by the writing on the wall, which Daniel interpreted on the night Babylon fell.

characters.name: Ahasuerus (Xerxes I)
characters.title: King of Persia

dates.note: Esther narrative years; Ezra 4:6 and Daniel 9:1 (likely different kings) omitted.

characters.summary: Persian king who deposed Vashti, made Esther queen and allowed the Jews to defend themselves against Haman's decree.

characters.name: Vashti
characters.title: Queen of Persia
characters.summary: Ahasuerus's queen, deposed for refusing to appear at his banquet, which opened the way for Esther.

characters.name: Artaxerxes I
characters.title: King of Persia
characters.summary: Persian king who commissioned Ezra and sent his cupbearer Nehemiah to rebuild Jerusalem's walls.

characters.name: Sanballat the Horonite
characters.title: Governor of Samaria
characters.summary: Chief opponent of Nehemiah who mocked, threatened and plotted against the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

characters.name: Tobiah the Ammonite
characters.title: Official
characters.summary: Sanballat's ally who opposed Nehemiah and was later thrown out of a temple storeroom.

characters.name: Zechariah
characters.title: Prophet of the Restoration
characters.summary: Prophet and contemporary of Haggai whose night visions and messianic oracles encouraged the temple rebuilders.

characters.name: Malachi
characters.title: Prophet
characters.summary: The last of the OT prophets, who challenged careless worship and promised the coming of "Elijah" before the Day of the LORD.

characters.name: Satan
characters.title: The Adversary
characters.summary: The accuser who afflicts Job, tempts Jesus in the wilderness and is finally defeated in Revelation.

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.title: Archangel
characters.summary: The angel who explained Daniel's visions and announced the births of John the Baptist and Jesus.

characters.name: Michael
characters.title: Archangel
characters.summary: The archangel and protector of Israel in Daniel who, in Revelation, leads heaven's armies against the dragon.

characters.name: Herod the Great
characters.title: King of Judea
characters.summary: Roman client king of Judea who rebuilt the temple and ordered the massacre of Bethlehem's infants.

characters.name: Zechariah (Zacharias)
characters.title: Priest, Father of John
characters.summary: An elderly priest struck mute for doubting Gabriel's promise of a son; at John's birth he sang the Benedictus.

characters.name: Elizabeth
characters.title: Mother of John the Baptist
characters.summary: Mary's relative who conceived John in old age and, filled with the Spirit, blessed Mary as "the mother of my Lord".

characters.name: Simeon
characters.title: Righteous Man of Jerusalem

dates.note: Theographic dates Luke 2:25 to AD 4 but Jesus’ birth to 3 BC; aligned to the presentation 40 days after the birth.

characters.summary: A devout man who took the infant Jesus in his arms at the temple and sang the Nunc Dimittis.

characters.name: Anna
characters.title: Prophetess

dates.note: Aligned to Jesus’ presentation at the temple (Luke 2:36).

characters.summary: An aged widow and prophetess who spoke of the infant Jesus to all awaiting Jerusalem's redemption.

characters.name: Philip the Apostle
characters.title: Apostle

dates.note: Theographic dates John 1 to AD 5; start adjusted to the beginning of Jesus’ ministry (c. AD 26).

characters.summary: A disciple from Bethsaida who brought Nathanael to Jesus and asked, "Lord, show us the Father".

characters.name: Nathanael
characters.title: Disciple

dates.note: Theographic dates John 1 to AD 5; start adjusted to the beginning of Jesus’ ministry (c. AD 26).

characters.summary: A disciple from Cana, "an Israelite in whom is no guile", often identified with Bartholomew.

characters.name: Thomas (Didymus)
characters.title: Apostle
characters.summary: The apostle who doubted the resurrection until he saw the risen Jesus, then confessed "My Lord and my God!"

characters.name: Nicodemus
characters.title: Pharisee & Ruler
characters.summary: A Pharisee who visited Jesus by night to hear of being "born again" and later helped bury him.

relationships.label: Came by night to; helped bury

characters.name: Zacchaeus
characters.title: Chief Tax Collector
characters.summary: A wealthy tax collector of Jericho who climbed a tree to see Jesus and repaid fourfold those he had cheated.

characters.name: Caiaphas
characters.title: High Priest
characters.summary: High priest who presided over Jesus' trial before the Sanhedrin and said one man should die for the people.

characters.name: Simon of Cyrene
characters.title: Cross-bearer
characters.summary: A man from Cyrene compelled to carry Jesus' cross; father of Alexander and Rufus.

characters.name: Jude (Judas), brother of Jesus
characters.title: Brother of Jesus
characters.summary: One of Jesus' brothers, traditionally the author of the Letter of Jude, which urges believers to contend for the faith.

characters.name: Philip the Evangelist
characters.title: Deacon & Evangelist
characters.summary: One of the seven deacons who preached in Samaria and baptized the Ethiopian eunuch.

characters.name: Cornelius
characters.title: Roman Centurion
characters.summary: A God-fearing centurion at Caesarea whose household was the first Gentile group baptized, by Peter.

characters.name: Silas (Silvanus)
characters.title: Missionary
characters.summary: A leader of the Jerusalem church who accompanied Paul on his second missionary journey and sang hymns in the Philippian jail.

characters.name: Luke
characters.title: Physician & Evangelist
characters.summary: Paul's "beloved physician" and travelling companion, traditionally the author of Luke and Acts.

characters.name: John Mark
characters.title: Evangelist
characters.summary: Barnabas's cousin who left Paul's first journey but later proved useful; traditionally the author of the Gospel of Mark.

characters.name: Lydia
characters.title: Merchant of Purple Cloth
characters.summary: A businesswoman of Thyatira, Paul's first convert in Europe, who hosted the church at Philippi.

characters.name: Apollos
characters.title: Teacher & Evangelist
characters.summary: An eloquent Alexandrian Jew instructed by Priscilla and Aquila who became an influential teacher at Corinth.

characters.name: Titus
characters.title: Missionary & Pastor
characters.summary: A Gentile co-worker of Paul who was sent to Corinth and left to organize the churches of Crete.

characters.name: Tychicus
characters.title: Messenger of Paul
characters.summary: A "beloved brother and faithful minister" from Asia who carried Paul's letters to Ephesus and Colossae.

characters.name: Epaphras
characters.title: Founder of the Colossian Church
characters.summary: A Colossian who first brought the gospel to his city and later shared Paul's imprisonment.

characters.name: Epaphroditus
characters.title: Messenger of Philippi
characters.summary: The Philippians' envoy who brought gifts to the imprisoned Paul and nearly died in the work.

characters.name: Onesimus
characters.title: Runaway Slave
characters.summary: Philemon's runaway slave who became a believer through Paul and was sent back "no longer as a slave but as a brother".

characters.name: Philemon
characters.title: Host of a House Church
characters.summary: A Colossian believer and slaveholder to whom Paul wrote, urging him to receive Onesimus as a brother.

characters.name: Apphia
characters.title: Member of Philemon's House Church
characters.summary: A believer greeted in the Letter to Philemon, possibly Philemon's wife.

characters.name: Archippus
characters.title: Fellow Soldier of Paul
characters.summary: A minister at Colossae greeted as Paul's "fellow soldier" and urged to fulfil his ministry.

characters.name: Euodia
characters.title: Co-worker of Paul
characters.summary: A woman of the Philippian church who laboured with Paul and was urged to agree with Syntyche.

characters.name: Syntyche
characters.title: Co-worker of Paul
characters.summary: A Philippian co-worker of Paul urged to be of the same mind as Euodia.

characters.name: Lois
characters.title: Grandmother of Timothy
characters.summary: Timothy's grandmother, praised by Paul for the sincere faith she passed to her family.

characters.name: Eunice
characters.title: Mother of Timothy
characters.summary: Timothy's Jewish-Christian mother who taught him the Scriptures from childhood.

characters.name: Onesiphorus
characters.title: Friend of Paul
characters.summary: An Ephesian who sought out the imprisoned Paul in Rome and "often refreshed" him.

characters.name: Demas
characters.title: Co-worker (later deserter)
characters.summary: A co-worker of Paul who later deserted him, "having loved this present world".

characters.name: Zenas
characters.title: Lawyer
characters.summary: A lawyer whom Paul asked Titus to help on his journey (Titus 3:13).

characters.name: Phoebe
characters.title: Deacon of Cenchreae
characters.summary: A deacon and patron of the church at Cenchreae, commended by Paul and likely the bearer of Romans.

characters.name: Tertius
characters.title: Scribe of Romans
characters.summary: The scribe who wrote down Paul's Letter to the Romans and added his own greeting (Rom 16:22).

characters.name: Sosthenes
characters.title: Co-sender of 1 Corinthians
characters.summary: A synagogue ruler at Corinth, beaten before Gallio, later named as co-sender of 1 Corinthians.

characters.name: Chloe
characters.title: Head of a Corinthian Household
characters.summary: A woman whose household reported the divisions in the Corinthian church to Paul.

characters.name: Stephanas
characters.title: First Convert in Achaia
characters.summary: Head of the first household converted in Achaia, baptized by Paul and devoted to serving the saints.

characters.name: Antonius Felix
characters.title: Roman Governor of Judea
characters.summary: Roman governor who heard Paul's defence, hoped for a bribe and left him imprisoned for two years.

characters.name: Porcius Festus
characters.title: Roman Governor of Judea
characters.summary: Felix's successor, before whom Paul appealed to Caesar.

characters.name: Herod Agrippa II
characters.title: King
characters.summary: Great-grandson of Herod the Great who heard Paul's defence and said, "In a short time you would persuade me to be a Christian".

characters.name: Reuben
characters.title: Firstborn of Jacob · Tribe of Reuben
characters.summary: Jacob's firstborn by Leah, who tried to rescue Joseph from his brothers but lost his birthright for sleeping with Bilhah.

characters.name: Simeon
characters.title: Son of Jacob · Tribe of Simeon
characters.summary: Leah's second son who, with Levi, avenged Dinah at Shechem; Joseph held him hostage in Egypt.

characters.name: Levi
characters.title: Son of Jacob · Priestly Tribe

dates.note: Death from his age of 137 (Exod 6:16).

characters.summary: Leah's third son, ancestor of Moses, Aaron and the priestly tribe that received no territory but served the sanctuary.

characters.name: Dan
characters.title: Son of Jacob · Tribe of Dan

dates.note: Alive at Jacob’s deathbed blessing (Gen 49); death year unknown.

characters.summary: First son of Rachel's servant Bilhah, named "judgement" by Rachel; ancestor of Samson.

characters.name: Naphtali
characters.title: Son of Jacob · Tribe of Naphtali

dates.note: Alive at Jacob’s deathbed blessing (Gen 49); death year unknown.

characters.summary: Bilhah's second son, whose name recalls Rachel's "wrestling"; his tribe's land in Galilee saw Jesus' ministry (Matt 4:15).

characters.name: Gad
characters.title: Son of Jacob · Tribe of Gad

dates.note: Alive at Jacob’s deathbed blessing (Gen 49); death year unknown.

characters.summary: First son of Leah's servant Zilpah, named for "good fortune"; his tribe settled east of the Jordan.

characters.name: Asher
characters.title: Son of Jacob · Tribe of Asher

dates.note: Alive at Jacob’s deathbed blessing (Gen 49); death year unknown.

characters.summary: Zilpah's second son, named "happy"; Anna the prophetess was of his tribe (Luke 2:36).

characters.name: Issachar
characters.title: Son of Jacob · Tribe of Issachar

dates.note: Alive at Jacob’s deathbed blessing (Gen 49); death year unknown.

characters.summary: Leah's fifth son; his tribe was later noted for men "who understood the times" (1 Chr 12:32).

characters.name: Zebulun
characters.title: Son of Jacob · Tribe of Zebulun

dates.note: Alive at Jacob’s deathbed blessing (Gen 49); death year unknown.

characters.summary: Leah's sixth son, blessed to "dwell at the shore of the sea"; his land in Galilee is named in Isaiah 9 and Matthew 4.

characters.name: Benjamin
characters.title: Youngest Son of Jacob · Tribe of Benjamin
characters.summary: Rachel's second son, born as she died; Jacob's cherished youngest and ancestor of King Saul and the apostle Paul.

characters.name: Bilhah
characters.title: Rachel's Servant
characters.summary: Rachel's handmaid, given to Jacob as a wife; mother of Dan and Naphtali.

characters.name: Zilpah
characters.title: Leah's Servant
characters.summary: Leah's handmaid, given to Jacob as a wife; mother of Gad and Asher.
